question: After Wurmcoil Engine dies and I get its two 3/3 tokens, do players need to be able to tell which token has deathtouch and which one has lifelink?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it must be clear to all players which token has deathtouch and which has lifelink.
expected.answer: It must be clear to all players which token has deathtouch and which token has lifelink.
